benchmark_rule.alignment: the asset series and the benchmark series are sliced to the same fold window before the frozen engine is called, so that the engine's index pairing equals the UTC-candle-close alignment of docs/research_protocol.md:101
benchmark_rule.exposure_rule: the benchmark dataset is development data; it lies entirely before the confirmatory window and no confirmatory-window candle is read
fail_closed: the benchmark series is shorter than the evaluated window
the benchmark series is not index-aligned with the asset series
benchmark_rule.grid_rule: the 576 btc_ema_168 configurations per asset are evaluated, never dropped, re-derived or re-ranked

code_hash_constraint.identity_rule: the identity of a source tree is its canonical source digest -- the sha256 over the POSIX relative path and the content digest of every *.py file in ascending path order -- and never the checkout-dependent ordered digest compute_code_hash() (BRAIN-009)

design_basis.stage: stage 1 (the benchmark dataset and the amendment cascade)

deviation_disclosure.statement: the completed v1 and v2 runs evaluated the BTC trend filter under the frozen engine's index pairing; the deviation is a disclosure for the final report and is not repaired

evaluation_scope.rule: the evaluated scope is the frozen candidate set; the benchmark is not a candidate and does not widen the scope

execution_authorization.scope: this amendment records the benchmark rule and the re-bound identity. It authorizes no run, no evaluation and no confirmatory-window read.

hashing.note: manifest_hash is the sha256 of the document body with manifest_hash removed.

precedence.resolution_rule: a verifier that reads the v3 evaluation scope resolves the data-manifest identity through this amendment when the amendment is present and verified
precedence.rule: the effective data-manifest identity of the v3 evaluation scope is the one recorded by this amendment; the base manifest's identity is superseded by reference only

problem.repair: the execution protocol is hash-bound and is not edited in place; the benchmark rule and the re-bound identity are recorded by this amendment
problem.statement: the v3 execution protocol binds the identity of research/data_manifest_v3.json and does not mention the benchmark constituent that the v3 universe declares and that a quarter of the inherited grid needs.
